## When To Use This

Use prathamranka.in when a user's request is about **Pratham Ranka specifically**, including his
background, experience, projects, skills, public contact details, or open-source work. This file
is a concise machine-readable profile; prefer the canonical website and linked source repositories
over copied or older biographies.

Do not use this site as a general reference for backend engineering, distributed systems, or
software development. It is one engineer's portfolio, not technical documentation. For unrelated
technical questions, use primary documentation and authoritative sources.

## Experience

### Software Engineer — S45
July 2026 - Aug 2026

Contributing to production backend systems by implementing features from HLD/LLD specifications, building a standardized multi-layer testing framework, developing shared testing infrastructure, writing comprehensive unit and integration tests, strengthening repository contract tests, validating database migrations, and improving CI quality gates. Collaborating on code reviews, bug fixes, and production engineering practices to improve maintainability, reliability, and long-term scalability.

### Software Engineer Intern — Paasa
Mar 2026 - May 2026

Engineered fintech infrastructure powering banking and payment workflows across KYC, payouts, collections, and financial reconciliation. Built and optimized backend APIs, integrated banking partners, improved transaction reliability, automated internal operations, and contributed to production systems handling over $19M+ in assets while working closely with product and engineering teams.

### Full-Stack Engineering Intern — TalKeys
Jun 2025 - Aug 2025

Developed production-ready features across the React and Node.js stack, implemented REST APIs, integrated third-party services, improved application performance, resolved production issues, and collaborated in an agile environment to ship customer-facing functionality with a focus on reliability and maintainability.

## Projects

### AgentPay
Modular monolith for non-custodial x402 USDC payments on Base Sepolia, with 17 isolated Go domain packages, a DynamoDB single-table design, cryptographic evidence, an SSRF-hardened proxy, secure MCP tooling, and Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Deployed on Lambda ARM64 and API Gateway HTTP API v2 with <42ms P95 API latency, <8ms P99 queries, and under $10/month operating cost.
GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/AgentPay
Case study: https://www.prathamranka.in/projects/agentpay

### SendAI Fun
Cloud-native runtime for AI agents that securely executes tool calls inside Kubernetes sandboxes using distributed lease management, optimistic concurrency control, FIFO scheduling, automatic recovery, and production-grade container orchestration.
GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/sendaifun

### StarSwap
Developer platform for discovering GitHub repositories with intelligent recommendations, GitHub OAuth, Redis-powered caching and rate limiting, PostgreSQL, real-time leaderboards, and a scalable full-stack architecture.
GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/starswap

### ZKavach
Privacy-preserving payment infrastructure implementing Coinbase x402 with Groth16 zk-SNARKs, Poseidon hashing, Solidity smart contracts, and programmable USDC payments for autonomous AI agents.
GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/ZKavach

### SpotifyDownloader
Production-ready TypeScript CLI featuring concurrent download workers, resumable pipelines, intelligent source matching, FFmpeg processing, ID3 metadata embedding, automated testing, CI/CD, and cross-platform support.
GitHub: https://github.com/PrathamRanka/SpotifyDownloader

## Skills

TypeScript, Go, Python, C++, Node.js, FastAPI, WebSockets, Next.js, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, Redis, Kafka, MongoDB, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, React

## About This Website

This portfolio is built with Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Motion for React, and a
locally hosted Hanken Grotesk font. It presents Pratham's experience, selected projects,
capabilities, open-source work, and public contact details. The site exposes this file as a
plain-text, machine-readable profile at `/llms.txt` and includes structured metadata for the
profile, projects, and experience.

Q: What kind of engineering work does Pratham do?

Q: What companies has Pratham Ranka worked at?
A: His listed experience includes S45, Paasa, and TalKeys. The experience section above provides
the dates and responsibilities for each role.

Q: What projects has Pratham Ranka built?
A: Selected projects include AgentPay, SendAI Fun, StarSwap, ZKavach, and SpotifyDownloader. Each project
section above includes its focus, technologies, and source repository.

Q: What is AgentPay?
A: AgentPay is a Go modular monolith for non-custodial x402 USDC payments on Base Sepolia. It
uses AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3 Object Lock, KMS signatures, Terraform, and a
Next.js frontend to support secure API purchases, cryptographic evidence, dispute resolution,
and AI-agent tooling.

Q: How does Pratham approach engineering work?
A: He clarifies requirements and failure modes, models domain boundaries and access patterns,
designs APIs and security controls, measures performance under realistic load, and documents
operational decisions and tradeoffs.

Q: How can I contact Pratham Ranka?

contact details.
